name: Modules.Crypto
description:
This module provides access to various encryption and decryption algorithms, and string encodings.

## Getting Started

View the [Using Titanium Modules](https://titaniumsdk.com/guide/Titanium_SDK/Titanium_SDK_How-tos/Using_Modules/) document for instructions on getting
started with using this module in your application. You can download the module from https://github.com/tidev/ti.crypto/releases

## Accessing the crypto Module

To access this module from JavaScript, you would do the following:

``` javascript
var crypto = require("ti.crypto");
```

The `crypto` variable is a reference to the Module object.

properties.name: STATUS_ALIGNMENTERROR
properties.summary:
Used in the [encodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#encodeData) and [Cryptor](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor) methods to report an error.
This means that the data you are passing is not correctly padded (specifically that the entire data length including padding is
not a multiple of the block size). The most likely cause is that you are truncating your encrypted data somewhere, possibly
outside of this routine.

Only reported by iOS (though the constant is still defined on Android).

properties.name: STATUS_BUFFERTOOSMALL
properties.summary:
Used in the [encodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#encodeData) and [Cryptor](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor) methods to report an error
when the buffer is not long enough to contain the result.

properties.name: STATUS_DECODEERROR
properties.summary:
Used in the [encodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#encodeData) and [Cryptor](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor) methods to report an error.
Input data did not decode or decrypt properly.

Only reported by iOS (though the constant is still defined on Android).

properties.name: STATUS_MEMORYFAILURE
properties.summary:

properties.name: STATUS_PARAMERROR
properties.summary:
Used in the [encodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#encodeData) and [Cryptor](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor) methods to report an error
with the supplied parameters or properties.

properties.name: STATUS_SUCCESS
properties.summary:
Used in the [reset](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor#reset) and [release](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor#release) methods
to report success for the operation.

properties.name: STATUS_UNIMPLEMENTED
properties.summary:
Used in the [getOutputLength](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor#getOutputLength) and various [Cryptor](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor) methods to report an error.
Typically used to indicate the given algorithm/mode is not implemented in this OS version.

Android will report this status only on [getOutputLength](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor#getOutputLength).
Otherwise this status is only reported by iOS for the methods performing operations.

properties.name: TYPE_BASE64STRING
properties.summary:
Used in the [encodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#encodeData) and [decodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#decodeData) methods
to specify expected string format. A Base64 encoded string.

properties.name: TYPE_BLOB
properties.summary: Used in the [encodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#encodeData) method to specify expected input is a Ti.Blob instance.

properties.name: TYPE_HEXSTRING
properties.summary:
Used in the [encodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#encodeData) and [decodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#decodeData) methods
to specify expected string format. A hexadecimal formatted string. Each byte is represented by 2 hexadecimal numbers.

methods.name: createCryptor
methods.summary: Creates and returns an instance of [Modules.Crypto.Cryptor](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor).

parameters.name: parameters
parameters.summary: Properties to set on a new object, including any defined by [Modules.Crypto.Cryptor](api:Modules.Crypto.Cryptor) except those marked not-creation or read-only.

methods.name: decodeData
methods.summary: Decodes a source buffer into a string using the specified data type. This is a codec method used for converting data from a source buffer into a displayable string.

inlined.name: DecodeDataDict
inlined.summary: Simple object passed to [Modules.Crypto.decodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#decodeData) to decode data into a Titanium.Buffer.

properties.name: source
properties.summary: The Titanium.Buffer to decode

properties.name: type
properties.summary:
The format of the returned string:

* [TYPE_BASE64STRING](api:Modules.Crypto#TYPE_BASE64STRING) - source is a base64 encoded string
* [TYPE_HEXSTRING](api:Modules.Crypto#TYPE_HEXSTRING) - source is a hexadecimal formatted string

methods.name: encodeData
methods.summary: Encodes the source into the destination buffer using the specified data type. This is a codec method used for converting data to a destination buffer.

inlined.name: EncodeDataDict
inlined.summary: Simple object passed to [Modules.Crypto.encodeData](api:Modules.Crypto#encodeData) to encode data into a Titanium.Buffer.

properties.name: dest
properties.summary: The Titanium.Buffer to receive the encoded data

properties.name: destPosition
properties.summary: The position in dest to set the encoded data (optional, default is 0)

properties.name: source
properties.summary: The data to encode (see 'type' for supported object types)

properties.name: type
properties.summary:
The data type of the source object:

* [TYPE_BASE64STRING](api:Modules.Crypto#TYPE_BASE64STRING) - source is a base64 encoded string
* [TYPE_HEXSTRING](api:Modules.Crypto#TYPE_HEXSTRING) - source is a hexadecimal formatted string
* [TYPE_BLOB](api:Modules.Crypto#TYPE_BLOB) - source is a Titanium.Blob object

returns.summary: Returns the position after the encoded data inside the destination.
